name: garage-log
description: Vehicle maintenance log: track services, schedules and costs for any vehicle.
author: Jordan Bastian

scripts.test: node scripts/check-mobile.js && node test/logic.test.js && node test/updater.test.js && node test/sync.test.js && node test/carfax.test.js && node test/car3d.test.js && node test/carlook.test.js && node test/themes.test.js && node test/fuel.test.js && node test/workorder.test.js
scripts.dist: npm run sync-version && node scripts/check-mobile.js && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.release: npm run sync-version && node scripts/check-mobile.js && npm test && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always && node scripts/publish-mobile.js
